nom: Mario Badescu Drying Lotion Blemish Spot Treatment

avis.titre: It works for me - even for stubborn spots!
avis.texte: In addition to my skin care routine, this drying lotion has helped remove stubborn acne within a day or two. I have had painful and persistant acne related to hormonal flares that hasnt responded to any other treatment - this not only soothes (after the initial mild sting) but has dried ALL of them ip…thats a first over here!

I have used this for many years to fight blemishes and break outs. Other treatments had stopped working for me. A friend lent me this treatment and it worked overnight just as she told me it would. My blemishes dry up overnight and I don't have new scars. I have shared this treatment with a lot of friends and it has worked for them, too.
This is a great product to have on hand! I use a Q-Tip to apply to a blemish before bed and wake up to it gone or almost gone.

avis.titre: One of my VERY few repeat purchases
avis.texte: literally game changer. I put it on acne and any part of my skin that even looks like it will turn into a bump, and my face is clear when i wake up. Half of the pink dots are gone in the morning where I'm more oily, but for whatever is left just rinse or wipe it off. Make sure you don't shake it!! But instead use a q tip to reach the bottom. This bottle has lasted me a long time too, much longer than i expected

This stuff works! I was skeptical & previously just used other "drying" products. I'm also a face picker so at the first sign of anything forming up, I use this & it stops it before anything starts. You need this product!!

Ive been using this as a spot treatment. It just doesn't work. Its supposed to dry the blemish out and it doesnt do that at all - in fact, it seems to cause the blemish to create *more* excretion, not less. Also its basically a small amount of pink "sidement" in a solution that keeps it moist. You need to dip a q-tip to the bottom of the bottle into the "sediment", which makes it messy to apply. There are creams that work far better and are much less messy. Tossed this after three uses.

avis.titre: Make sure to shake the bottle.
avis.texte: Bought this on sale and thought I would give it a try. Never had problems with breaking out till now in my late 30s maybe a hormone discount. I found this product to be very helpful when out of us that I would get a white head or a pimple put it on go to sleep woke up and almost away. Make sure you shake the bottle before you use it so it's more activity.

Pimple patches work so much better. This did nothing for me. For night use, if you move once in your sleep the product comes off. I tried using it during the day, put it on at 10am, when i checked it at 10:30am, product was gone and I made sure not to touch my face. Truly useless. Get the pimple patches from Hero instead.

This drying lotion is meant to target single pimples and dry them out! It works best as a final touch on nightly skincare routine. Wash, moisturize and then apply this to spots. Also try regular salicylic acid or witch hazel

This is my 4th bottle of this. It is the best product for minimizing/drying blemishes overnight. I've multiple brands of the popular dot/sticker blemish treatments and none have worked half as well or at all.
This product works fast every time. I'm a huge fan of Mario Badescu products!

avis.texte: I really liked this drying lotion back in 2021, but I don't know if the ingredients changed or what but it doesn't work anymore. It will just sit on top of pimples and I reapply over and over again. Nothing happens. Honestly just grab pimple patches.
I got this a christmas present and i made manh of my pimple tiny in 3 days took away cystic acne in 2 days.
Glass bottle is sturdy and product itself is good like it as an acne spot treatment.

This takes multiple days of consistent use to see any results. Sometimes I put it on a red pimple and the next day its a white head that ends up popping, which is what I was trying to avoid. Other times I use it and it just doesn't shrink my pimples at all. I wish I could recommend it but I can't.
I have used this product for a number of years and am always satisfied with the results. It dries up the blemishes and heal the skin. This product is used in the evening.

I've been trying to like this product, but I just can't get results from it. I've used it per directions and online tips, but it's done nothing for me. For the price point, I would just go for some pimple patches.
It ONLY worked on my dry spots on my face. It did reduce the redness but then I tried it on an old scar/wound because i had a flare up and the scar came right back with the inflammation.

Im 37 and been struggling with hormonal acne- primarily on my chin, jawline and neck- for the past year. After trying dozens of products that didn't work, i decided to try a sulfur based treatment. After applying my serums, I use the cloudburst moisturizer by Earth Harbor, and then I use this drying lotion on my trouble zones every night as the final step. After about a week of this routine, my acne has cleared up soooo much! I still get a tiny bit of congestion on my jawline, but this has reduction pimple flare ups more than anything id previously tried. This is a great product! Kate Summerville also makes a product like this, but the ingredients are almost identical, and this is half the price. Im already on my 2nd bottle.

avis.titre: Works Amazing for My Cystic Acne
avis.texte: I get painful pustules that usually multiply if I pop them, but this drying lotion has been a game changer. It helps shrink them fast—usually overnight—and if I keep applying it, the spot goes away completely. I'm left with just a small red dot that fades over time. To avoid dryness, I make sure to moisturize in the morning after washing my face (I've been using baby shampoo in the morning since my skin stays clean overnight). At night, I wash with my acne face wash, moisturize, then apply the drying lotion directly to spots. It really works if you're consistent, and it hasn't irritated my skin at all. Highly recommend for stubborn breakouts!
Didn't do too much. I still have acne spots and my cystic acne is still there. I returned it and someone recommend the Murad one and it was a game changer for my hormonal cystic break outs!

This product does work wonders. My only downside is that because its chalky and has to dry on the skin you cam only apply it at night. Which leaves my husband entertained by my pink spots. It really does work great though. Slight burning upon application but goes away within 5 seconds
even tho its not as fast as advertised it still does get rid of the pimple in like a day which is still pretty good for the price

I keep this on hand ALWAYS. I no longer have frequent issues w/ clogged pores but every once in a while, something I apply (sunscreen, etc.) creates a problem. I apply this at night and VOILA, the redness and /or sore spot is significantly reduced or absolutely gone in the morning. I marvel at the (apparent) simplicity of this. I can tell there is calamine (pink) in it and it must have rubbing alcohol, too; whatever the proportions are .... the marvelous combo of ingredients in this makes it a "must-have."
This worked on my cystic acne and even hacked the scarring afterwards!

This stuff really works! I dont suffer from a lot of acne these days, but when I do get some it tends to be 1-2 monster pimples. This stuff always, always helps their appearance overnight. It has a strong smell, but goes away once it dries. Apply it before bed and be sure to leave enough time for it to fully dry.
